description: This file defines the LogNode interface, which specifies a contract for logging components capable of outputting log data. It includes a method 'println' for logging messages with specified priority, tag, message, and optional exception.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface for logging nodes that can output log messages and be chained together. Defines the 'println' method to log messages with a specified priority, tag, message, and throwable.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message with the given priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable to the log target.
